title: WardRegion
description: Region protection plugin for Minecraft 1.21 with wand-based selection, GUI management, whitelist access, flexible flags, particle previews, and MySQL storage.
body:
This plugin adds simple region management and protection for Minecraft servers running on 1.21.

Players or administrators can create cuboid regions using a selection wand, save them by name, and manage them through the `/region` command and in-game GUI menus. Regions cannot overlap, and they must be created within the same world.

Each region supports a whitelist system and configurable protection flags. The plugin currently includes flags for block breaking, block placing, interaction, and entity damage. Each flag can be set to allow everyone, allow only whitelisted players, or deny everyone.

The plugin also includes quality-of-life features such as particle previews for selected region borders and title messages when entering a region. Region data, whitelist entries, and flag states are stored in MySQL.

This project is focused on practical region protection and lightweight management. It does not aim to be a full replacement for large protection suites with advanced claim systems or economy features.
